info.title: EXCLURAD eta cos theta* scan setup

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Eta: scan cos theta* from -1 to +1 in 5 steps at W = 1.7, Q2 = 1.5, phi* = 90.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
Checking the eta channel constraints first so I can validate the requested scan and generate EXCLURAD-ready input only if the kinematics pass.

parts.text: The requested eta scan is valid except at the exact poles. I’m applying the validated EXCLURAD fix of clamping `cos(theta*) = +/-1` to `+/-0.999`, then generating the input file and recording that correction in `outcome.json`.
Applying the pole-safe correction the code requires, then writing `outcome.json` next to the generated input.
